title: Persistent checkpoints and authenticated human resume
scope: Persist workflow state and interrupt at consequential actions; bind resume to actor, case version and approved payload

acceptance.text: Persist workflow state and interrupt at consequential actions; bind resume to actor, case version and approved payload
Restart worker at interrupt; reject unauthorized resume; prove no duplicate side effect
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a human-review PR

verification: Restart worker at interrupt; reject unauthorized resume; prove no duplicate side effect

evidence.text: ai/workflows/human_checkpoints.py (ADR-014) persists runs with the official langgraph-checkpoint-sqlite 3.1.2 SqliteSaver on an explicit file and threads scoped to tenant/case/run; draft_action -> await_approval (interrupt before any outward action) -> apply_approved_action. resume_with_approval validates against the persisted draft before resuming: authenticated supervisor who is the TAX-046 approved_by (not proposer or agent), same tenant/case/draft/outcome, approved status, same case_version and SHA-256 payload digest (TAX-046 canonical JSON). The node re-validates so direct Command resumes re-pause.

tests/ai/test_human_checkpoints.py (12 tests, 12 rejection subtests) on a real SQLite file: a separate Python process pauses at the interrupt and exits, the test process resumes with a valid approval and the action applies once. Unauthenticated, missing identity, cross-tenant, wrong case/draft/outcome, unapproved, non-supervisor, non-approver, self/agent approval, stale case version and changed payload are each refused with the run still paused, then the real approver succeeds. Second resume -> no_pending_checkpoint; crash after side effect -> recover_run replays with the same idempotency key, one applied effect; recovery cannot skip approval; port timeout recorded as failed. .venv-ai pytest tests/ai: 111 passed; ai.smoke passed; ruff/mypy (116 files) pass; lock verified in clean 3.13 venv (pip check OK).

Tests and evidence recorded on task/TAX-047 (criteria 1-2). Branch refreshed from main and pushed explicitly; human-review PR https://github.com/Vati-AI/rsl-taxathon/pull/138 opened with ADR-014, checks and Windows-only environment exceptions documented. Agent will not merge.

notes.text: Agent finished implementation and opened human review. task.py finish steps run individually: its dev.py check/quality.py gate fails on this Windows checkout only (POSIX file-mode tooling tests; CRLF vs Prettier), documented in the PR.
